2607.03386.title: When Aggregate Alignment Misleads: Auditing Policy Repair Without Per-State Expert Actions
2607.03386.paper_summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly used to edit, refine, and repair decision policies, but evaluating these edits is difficult when per-state expert action labels are unavailable. We study this problem in a hotel-pricing simulator where an agentic policy editor receives only region-level diagnostic feedback: summaries of how its price distribution differs from a benchmark policy across time, inventory, and market regions. The editor cannot observe benchmark actions, benchmark source code, reward numbers, or held-out outcomes, and may only propose constrained edits to a target-action table. On 5,000 held-out episodes, a multi-restart LLM editor reaches RevPAR 108.47 (95% CI 107.61 - 109.34), close to the benchmark policy's 108.75 (107.81 - 109.68), with paired gap (LLM minus benchmark) -0.276 and 95% CI [-0.692, 0.146]. A cheap diagnostic projection already recovers much of the revenue (107.90), so the LLM editor's distinctive gain is not raw revenue lift alone: it also reduces episode composition distance from 1.153 to 0.609. This is the strongest non-benchmark repair result. This profile is not explained by restart search alone: non-semantic proposers with up to 2,500 evaluations fall 8.77 - 14.57 RevPAR points short. Nor is it explained by plausible prompt format: a shuffled-diagnostic control breaks region-error correspondence and falls to RevPAR 94.30. The match is genuine but partial. A tree editor achieves stronger pooled alignment, 0.214 versus 0.266, and stronger reference-state D1, 0.328 versus 1.197, yet revenue falls to 98.91. These results show that agentic policy repair should be evaluated by whether diagnostic feedback becomes reliable closed-loop outcome, not by a single behavioral distance.
2607.03386.paper_summary_zh: 代理 AI 系統越來越多地用於編輯、精煉和修復決策政策，但當缺乏每個狀態的專家行動標籤時，評估這些編輯變得困難。我們在一個酒店定價模擬器中研究這個問題，其中一個代理政策編輯器僅獲得區域級的診斷反饋：其價格分佈與基準政策在時間、庫存和市場區域之間的差異摘要。編輯器無法觀察基準行動、基準源代碼、獎勵數字或保留的結果，並且只能對目標行動表提出有限的編輯。在 5,000 次保留的實驗中，一個多重重啟的 LLM 編輯器達到 RevPAR 108.47（95% CI 107.61 - 109.34），接近基準政策的 108.75（107.81 - 109.68），配對差距（LLM 減去基準）為 -0.276，95% CI [-0.692, 0.146]。一個便宜的診斷預測已經恢復了大部分收入（107.90），因此 LLM 編輯器的獨特增益不僅僅是原始收入的提升：它還將實驗組合距離從 1.153 降低到 0.609。這是最強的非基準修復結果。這一特徵並不是僅由重啟搜索解釋的：非語義提議者在最多 2,500 次評估中短缺 8.77 - 14.57 RevPAR 點。也不是由合理的提示格式解釋的：一個隨機診斷控制打破了區域錯誤對應，降至 RevPAR 94.30。這種匹配是真實的，但不完全。一個樹編輯器實現了更強的合併對齊，0.214 對比 0.266，以及更強的參考狀態 D1，0.328 對比 1.197，但收入降至 98.91。這些結果顯示，代理政策修復應該通過診斷反饋是否成為可靠的閉環結果來評估，而不是通過單一的行為距離。
2607.03386.author: Peiying Zhu et.al.
